---
title: "Interactive Collision Simulation"
format: html
---

## Two Objects Colliding

Adjust the sliders to see how elastic collisions work!

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

viewof velocity1 = Inputs.range([1, 10], {value: 5, step: 0.5, label: "Velocity 1 (→)"})
viewof velocity2 = Inputs.range([1, 10], {value: 5, step: 0.5, label: "Velocity 2 (←)"})
viewof mass1 = Inputs.range([1, 20], {value: 10, step: 1, label: "Mass 1"})
viewof mass2 = Inputs.range([1, 20], {value: 10, step: 1, label: "Mass 2"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

{
  // Calculate final velocities (elastic collision)
  const v1_initial = velocity1;
  const v2_initial = -velocity2;  // negative because moving left
  
  const v1_final = ((mass1 - mass2) * v1_initial + 2 * mass2 * v2_initial) / (mass1 + mass2);
  const v2_final = ((mass2 - mass1) * v2_initial + 2 * mass1 * v1_initial) / (mass1 + mass2);
  
  // Calculate momentum
  const p_initial = mass1 * v1_initial + mass2 * v2_initial;
  const p_final = mass1 * v1_final + mass2 * v2_final;
  
  // Canvas setup
  const width = 700;
  const height = 400;
  const svg = d3.create("svg")
    .attr("width", width)
    .attr("height", height)
    .attr("style", "background: #f9f9f9");
  
  // Before collision (top half)
  const beforeY = height * 0.25;
  const afterY = height * 0.75;
  
  // Title for before
  svg.append("text")
    .attr("x", width / 2)
    .attr("y", 30)
    .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
    .attr("font-size", "16px")
    .attr("font-weight", "bold")
    .text("Before Collision");
  
  // Title for after
  svg.append("text")
    .attr("x", width / 2)
    .attr("y", height / 2 + 30)
    .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
    .attr("font-size", "16px")
    .attr("font-weight", "bold")
    .text("After Collision");
  
  // Center lines
  svg.append("line")
    .attr("x1", width/2)
    .attr("y1", 50)
    .attr("x2", width/2)
    .attr("y2", height/2 - 20)
    .attr("stroke", "#ccc")
    .attr("stroke-dasharray", "5,5");
    
  svg.append("line")
    .attr("x1", width/2)
    .attr("y1", height/2 + 50)
    .attr("x2", width/2)
    .attr("y2", height - 20)
    .attr("stroke", "#ccc")
    .attr("stroke-dasharray", "5,5");
  
  // Object 1 before (blue, left side)
  const radius1 = Math.sqrt(mass1) * 4;
  const radius2 = Math.sqrt(mass2) * 4;
  
  svg.append("circle")
    .attr("cx", width * 0.25)
    .attr("cy", beforeY)
    .attr("r", radius1)
    .attr("fill", "blue")
    .attr("opacity", 0.7);
  
  // Arrow for object 1 before
  svg.append("line")
    .attr("x1", width * 0.25)
    .attr("y1", beforeY)
    .attr("x2", width * 0.25 + v1_initial * 15)
    .attr("y2", beforeY)
    .attr("stroke", "blue")
    .attr("stroke-width", 3)
    .attr("marker-end", "url(#arrowblue)");
  
  // Object 2 before (red, right side)
  svg.append("circle")
    .attr("cx", width * 0.75)
    .attr("cy", beforeY)
    .attr("r", radius2)
    .attr("fill", "red")
    .attr("opacity", 0.7);
  
  // Arrow for object 2 before
  svg.append("line")
    .attr("x1", width * 0.75)
    .attr("y1", beforeY)
    .attr("x2", width * 0.75 + v2_initial * 15)
    .attr("y2", beforeY)
    .attr("stroke", "red")
    .attr("stroke-width", 3)
    .attr("marker-end", "url(#arrowred)");
  
  // Labels before
  svg.append("text")
    .attr("x", width * 0.25)
    .attr("y", beforeY + radius1 + 20)
    .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
    .attr("font-size", "12px")
    .text(`m=${mass1}, v=${v1_initial.toFixed(1)}`);
  
  svg.append("text")
    .attr("x", width * 0.75)
    .attr("y", beforeY + radius2 + 20)
    .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
    .attr("font-size", "12px")
    .text(`m=${mass2}, v=${velocity2.toFixed(1)}`);
  
  // Object 1 after (slightly left of center)
  svg.append("circle")
    .attr("cx", width * 0.45)
    .attr("cy", afterY)
    .attr("r", radius1)
    .attr("fill", "blue")
    .attr("opacity", 0.7);
  
  // Arrow for object 1 after
  svg.append("line")
    .attr("x1", width * 0.45)
    .attr("y1", afterY)
    .attr("x2", width * 0.45 + v1_final * 15)
    .attr("y2", afterY)
    .attr("stroke", "blue")
    .attr("stroke-width", 3)
    .attr("marker-end", "url(#arrowblue)");
  
  // Object 2 after (slightly right of center)
  svg.append("circle")
    .attr("cx", width * 0.55)
    .attr("cy", afterY)
    .attr("r", radius2)
    .attr("fill", "red")
    .attr("opacity", 0.7);
  
  // Arrow for object 2 after
  svg.append("line")
    .attr("x1", width * 0.55)
    .attr("y1", afterY)
    .attr("x2", width * 0.55 + v2_final * 15)
    .attr("y2", afterY)
    .attr("stroke", "red")
    .attr("stroke-width", 3)
    .attr("marker-end", "url(#arrowred)");
  
  // Labels after
  svg.append("text")
    .attr("x", width * 0.45)
    .attr("y", afterY + radius1 + 20)
    .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
    .attr("font-size", "12px")
    .text(`m=${mass1}, v=${v1_final.toFixed(1)}`);
  
  svg.append("text")
    .attr("x", width * 0.55)
    .attr("y", afterY + radius2 + 20)
    .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
    .attr("font-size", "12px")
    .text(`m=${mass2}, v=${v2_final.toFixed(1)}`);
  
  // Arrow markers
  svg.append("defs").append("marker")
    .attr("id", "arrowblue")
    .attr("markerWidth", 10)
    .attr("markerHeight", 10)
    .attr("refX", 8)
    .attr("refY", 3)
    .attr("orient", "auto")
    .append("polygon")
    .attr("points", "0 0, 10 3, 0 6")
    .attr("fill", "blue");
  
  svg.append("defs").append("marker")
    .attr("id", "arrowred")
    .attr("markerWidth", 10)
    .attr("markerHeight", 10)
    .attr("refX", 8)
    .attr("refY", 3)
    .attr("orient", "auto")
    .append("polygon")
    .attr("points", "0 0, 10 3, 0 6")
    .attr("fill", "red");
  
  // Momentum info at bottom
  svg.append("text")
    .attr("x", width / 2)
    .attr("y", height - 5)
    .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
    .attr("font-size", "14px")
    .attr("font-weight", "bold")
    .text(`Momentum: Initial = ${p_initial.toFixed(2)}, Final = ${p_final.toFixed(2)} (Conserved: ${Math.abs(p_initial - p_final) < 0.01})`);
  
  return svg.node();
}
```

## How It Works

- **Blue object** (left) moves right with velocity `velocity1`
- **Red object** (right) moves left with velocity `velocity2`  
- After collision, velocities change based on conservation of momentum and energy
- Object size represents mass (larger = heavier)
- Momentum is always conserved!
